office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor cases for the City of Seattle for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting Seattle Municipal Court Judge Cat McDowall, on the court since 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Seattle Municipal Court judge since 2020 who presides over the Domestic Violence Intervention Project; previously a senior deputy prosecutor and civil attorney.
highlights: Appointed in September 2020; elected to a full term in 2022 [S2]
Presides over the Domestic Violence Intervention Project; co-directs Seattle Youth Traffic Court [S1][S2]
Former King County senior deputy prosecutor [S2]
